alert_settings_range_chk.name: alert_settings_range_chk
alert_settings_range_chk.value: ("alert_settings"."low_mg_dl" is null and "alert_settings"."high_mg_dl" is null) or ("alert_settings"."low_mg_dl" between 20 and 600 and "alert_settings"."high_mg_dl" between 20 and 600 and "alert_settings"."low_mg_dl" < "alert_settings"."high_mg_dl")

alert_settings_enabled_chk.name: alert_settings_enabled_chk
alert_settings_enabled_chk.value: not "alert_settings"."range_enabled" or ("alert_settings"."low_mg_dl" is not null and "alert_settings"."high_mg_dl" is not null)
